products.name: Asana AI
products.note: Work management AI; goal tracking; team productivity analytics; data residency options

profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (Nasdaq: ASAN, CIK 0001477720) whose platform is designed for teams that include both human workers and AI agents. The company describes its software as enabling teams to plan, automate, and execute critical workflows together, with AI agents operating inside those workflows rather than as separate tools.

Asana's primary AI offering, listed as Asana AI, centers on what the company calls Agentic Work Management, which brings together pre-built AI agents the company calls AI Teammates, a workflow builder called AI Studio, a dashboard product called Asana Dash, and integration layers through MCP and AI Connectors. The platform uses a structure the company refers to as the Work Graph, which provides AI agents with shared memory and context drawn from completed tasks, feedback, and user preferences, so that workflows carry forward accumulated knowledge rather than requiring repeated context-setting. Users can also build custom AI Teammates from their team's existing processes to handle coordination-heavy work.

The held facts note that Asana has a verified profile on this site, no recorded litigation, and no MCP server registry presence at the time of verification.
